infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: VantraRun does not save anything to your photo library. It only reads the one photo or video you choose as the background of a post.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: VantraRun reads running workouts, heart rate and available GPS routes from Apple Health only when you choose to import a run. It never writes to Apple Health.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: VantraRun does not save anything to Apple Health. It only reads the runs you choose to import.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: VantraRun uses your location during a run to measure distance and pace and to follow your route, including while the screen is locked. Location is only used while a run is in progress.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: VantraRun connects to your heart-rate strap or watch to show live heart rate during a run.

plugins.photosPermission: VantraRun opens your photo library only when you tap "Choose a photo or video" to put a background on a post you are making. Only the one you pick is used, and it is uploaded only when you tap Post.
plugins.cameraPermission: VantraRun uses the camera only when you tap "Take a photo" to put a background on a post you are making. The photo is uploaded only when you tap Post.
plugins.microphonePermission: VantraRun does not record sound. The camera is used for photos only; a video you add to a post is one you choose from your library, and it plays without sound.

extra.scope: VantraRun run coach (GPS, zones, cues, directions) plus read-only Apple Health and Health Connect manual import.
